name: Mexico City
tagline: The mole that's been fermenting for over a decade, and the street taco that won — then lost — a Michelin star.

Pujol.description: Avant-garde Mexican cuisine from Jorge Vallejo and Alejandra Flores. The mole madre, fermenting for over a decade now, is the house signature.

El Califa de León.description: The world's first taquería to hold a Michelin star (2024) — and also the first to lose it (2026). The gaonera taco that broke the internet.

Siembra Comedor.description: A tortillería and dining room devoted to heirloom corn in Polanco. It's the only tortillería recognized by the Michelin Guide, with a Bib Gourmand.

El Cardenal.description: Breakfasts of conchas with cream and hot chocolate since 1969, in the heart of the Historic Center.

Nicos.description: Traditional neighborhood Mexican cooking in Clavería, a favorite of the local food scene.
